findings.rationale: Claim: rewrite_compose_statements collects a fallible alias-resolution result and calls expect, while resolve_alias_qualified_name returns Err for an undeclared namespace. A user-authored common init containing a ForAll binder with an unknown alias-qualified type, or a quantified/aggregate binder in an expression, therefore panics rather than returning the CoreError promised by lower_compose. Evidence status: source-supported but not executed; requested evidence is a regression test with an unknown alias in a common-init binder.

Claim: rewrite_statement records a ForAll binder in the nested bound set and rewrite_expr respects that set, but rewrite_lvalue has no bound parameter and unconditionally sends Var and Index base names through rewrite_state_name. If a ForAll binder shadows a component state name, an assignment target is rewritten to alias__state while the right-hand variable remains the local binder, silently changing a local write into a component-state write. Evidence status: source-supported but language admissibility and runtime behavior were not executed; requested evidence is a lowering test with a binder whose name equals a state name.
